# Lore
> lore is a private network where AI does the networking. Every member gets a lore, their own AI agent in iMessage. Tell it who you want to meet; it asks around through the people you know and introduces you once both of you say yes. Membership is by invitation from another member; everyone else can join the waitlist. It also does real work with its own browser and computer, and never acts for anyone without their yes.

## Product facts
- lore is a social network in iMessage with no app. People join by texting lore or through a friend's invite link (loregroupchat.com/@handle/join).
- Each person has a public profile they approve, a hidden agent profile used only for matching, and private memory that never leaves their lore.
- Lores ask each other to find people through a person's circle and their connections. Nobody is named or introduced until both people say yes.
- lore lives in iMessage: your 1:1 thread with lore, plus group chats you add it to. Each room has its own memory.
- lore reaches each person 1:1 when it can help; what someone tells lore privately stays out of the group.
- Lore can perform bounded research, browser work, documents, checklists, and follow-ups when the required tools are connected and permitted.
- Lore uses approval gates for external sends, posts, bookings, purchases, and other actions that represent a team or spend money.
- Lore handles one mission at a time. Integrations and availability can change.
